quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
quests.hint: Compare the two options for "crash": one is a voiceless velar plosive, the other a voiced velar plosive. Listen closely for the difference between them.
quests.explanation: In "crash", the target sound is /k/, made by raising the back of the tongue to the soft palate with no voice. The distractor /g/ would instead require raising the back of the tongue to the soft palate with the voice on — a clearly different sound once you isolate it.
quests.mouthPosition: Raise the back of your tongue to the soft palate with no voice.

quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
